hints: logic inputs DIN, CLK, LOAD: VIH ≥ 3.5 V, VIL ≤ 0.8 V at V+ = 5 V ± 10 % (electrical characteristics, p. 3)
drives common-cathode displays: DIG0–DIG7 sink the digit current (pulled to V+ when off), SEG A–G and DP source the segment current (pulled to GND when off) (pin description, p. 5)
maximum recommended segment current 40 mA; with the scan limit at 1, 2 or 3 digits at most 10, 20 or 30 mA (Table 9, p. 10)
dissipation PD = V+ × 8 mA + (V+ − VLED) × duty × ISEG × N (N segments, worst case 8); wide SO 941 mW, derated 11.8 mW/°C above +70 °C; θJA 85 °C/W, TJ max. 150 °C (p. 2, 11)

serial data: 16-bit packets, MSB (D15) first, shifted in on CLK's rising edge, out of DOUT on the falling edge 16.5 clock cycles later; daisy-chain DOUT to the next DIN with LOAD in common (p. 5–6, 10)
on power-up the display is blanked and in shutdown mode – program it before use (p. 7)
